Container.Name: mcp-adguard
Container.Overview: AdGuard Home MCP server (Rust) — exposes an AdGuard Home instance as MCP tools over streamable-HTTP for AI agents. This wraps nicholaswilde/adguardhome-mcp-rs's stdio mode with supergateway rather than running their image or their native HTTP mode directly — two independent upstream bugs: (1) their published Docker images are broken (GLIBC_2.38 not found), and (2) their native HTTP transport 422s on any JSON-RPC notification (id-less messages are legitimate per spec, including notifications/initialized that every real MCP client sends) — their stdio mode doesn't have that problem. Source: mcp/adguard-gateway in this repo's sibling project, built by GitHub Actions on every push. If you run more than one AdGuard Home node (they don't sync DNS rewrites), install this template once per node under a different container name (e.g. mcp-adguard, mcp-adguard-2), changing ADGUARD_HOST/SUPERGATEWAY_PORT/ExtraParams each time. Set ExtraParams below to bind only to this server's Tailscale IP instead of all interfaces (e.g. -p 100.101.102.103:8904:8904) — replace with your own Tailscale IP and port.

Config.Name: SUPERGATEWAY_PORT
Config.Description: Port inside the container — must match the container-side port in ExtraParams
